description: Built February 1971; delivered 26 February 1971; registered 2 April 1971 as CCCP-87798 to the Uzbek Civil Aviation Directorate at Tashkent-Yuzhny; struck off 19 November 1987; erected in the Park of Culture at Dustabad; still carries the Aeroflot scheme and the number 87798; year_built from the registry's stated build month
